title: Samphassasuttaṃ
text: 315 . Sāvatthinidānaṃ . ‘‘Yo kho, bhikkhave, cakkhusamphassassa uppādo ṭhiti…pe… jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo…pe… yo manosamphassassa uppādo ṭhiti…pe… jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo. Yo ca kho, bhikkhave, cakkhusamphassassa nirodho…pe… jarāmaraṇassa atthaṅgamo…pe… yo manosamphassassa nirodho…pe… jarāmaraṇassa atthaṅgamo’’ti. Catutthaṃ.
